feature.label: Putman REST Client
feature.description: Putman is a REST API client for Eclipse, inspired by Postman. Send HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS), inspect responses in Raw, JSON, or HTML format, and manage multiple request tabs — all inside your Eclipse IDE.
